responsibility: This file is the top-level entry module for the mc translator executable in the mc-boot front end. Its responsibility is to connect process startup to compiler execution by registering mcStream temporary-file cleanup with libc atexit, enabling exit-on-halt behavior in M2RTS, invoking mcOptions to parse command-line arguments, and then handing the resulting configuration to mcComp_compile; beyond that orchestration it only provides the module init/fini hooks used by the runtime startup framework.
